metadata.title: Decouple Toggle Switch from Calculation Order

story.iWant: to remove the toggle switch's control over calculation order
story.soThat: it can be repurposed for controlling the filter randomization/AM LFO effect
story.tasks: - Analyze current toggle switch implementation - Fix calculation order to optimal default - Refactor toggle switch handler - Verify audio quality - Verify overdrive button independence - Add debug output and verification - Testing and validation

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Toggle switch (B8) button handler disconnected from calculation order logic 2. Calculation order fixed to optimal default setting 3. No regression in audio processing quality 4. Existing overdrive functionality (B7) remains unchanged 5. Code refactored to remove or bypass calculation order toggle infrastructure 6. Serial debug confirms switch no longer affects calculation order 7. Audio output verified to remain consistent regardless of switch position

artifacts.code: - main.cpp:99 - Toggle switch debounce and reading - main.cpp:102 - Toggle state variable - main.cpp:20 - Toggle switch declaration - Look for calculation order variables/logic
artifacts.dependencies: - DaisyPatchSM hardware abstraction - Epic 1 state persistence completed - Button/switch handling infrastructure

story-context.constraints: - Must not affect existing overdrive functionality - Must maintain audio quality - Must preserve state persistence from Epic 1 - Must not introduce audio glitches
story-context.interfaces: - Toggle switch hardware (B8) - Audio callback processing chain - MIDI debug output - Settings struct for persistence

tests.standards: - Manual testing required for audio quality - Test with oscilloscope or audio analyzer - Power cycle testing for state persistence
tests.locations: - AudioCallback function for processing tests - Button handler for switch behavior tests
tests.ideas: - Test all button combinations - Rapid toggle testing - Audio quality comparison before/after - Verify no calculation order changes with toggle
